## Checklist

- [ ] The package stays game-agnostic (no game names, paths or namespaces)
- [ ] Pixel art is untouched: no smoothing, anti-aliasing or interpolation on the Rig path
- [ ] `tools/posetests` passes (for pose / rig changes)
- [ ] `package/README.md`, `package/CHANGELOG.md` and the version in `package/package.json` are updated (for user-visible changes)
- [ ] No model files or other large binaries are included
